name: Yukari Matsuoka
source:
Slightly childish, Yukari is a pure hearted old friend of Kazu. Since childhood, Yukari's hobby has always been painting and competing in fine art competitions 
The accident made her bewildered, unable to find passion again in her work. After some trouble in the beginning, Yukari finally warms up with Kazu and is enthusiastic about rekindling her past friendship with him, but her work ethic still falters.
translation:
Slightly childish, Yukari is a pure hearted old friend of Kazu. Since childhood, Yukari's hobby has always been painting and competing in fine art competitions 
The accident made her bewildered, unable to find passion again in her work. After some trouble in the beginning, Yukari finally warms up with Kazu and is enthusiastic about rekindling her past friendship with him, but her work ethic still falters.
